reviews.name: Guest from Heythuysen
reviews.comment: good wine needs no bush!

reviews.name: Guest from Fredericton
reviews.comment: The stay was wonderful. The views were amazing. I did find it odd to be asked when we wanted to eat breakfast and then arrive and it was almost full. It was fine we didn’t mind sharing a table. I found the shower products very nice. Some of the best. And the fan was a pleasant find as I am use to one when I sleep. Overall a wonderful stay and an amazing property!

reviews.name: Guest from MOUTFORT
reviews.comment: We stayed one night at Cuilcheanna House B&B and had a wonderful experience. The house is lovely, comfortable and welcoming, and everything was perfect. The breakfast was excellent and made with high-quality products. Emma, the owner, is absolutely lovely and made us feel very welcome. We would happily come back and highly recommend this B&B!

reviews.name: Guest from Penrith
reviews.comment: We had a wonderful stay at Cuilcheanna House. It was a perfect location as our family were staying on Bunree Caravan Park five minutes along the road. We stayed in the room Mull, a beautiful room with bay window and smaller window looking onto the loch with the most superb views on a gorgeous sunny day. Breakfast was delicious and we particularly enjoyed being able to use fresh milk from the fridge for our teas and coffees in our room. Access to a lovely beach was a real plus. Wish we could have stayed longer and will definitely return.

reviews.name: Guest from FRESNES (94260)
reviews.comment: your hotel is very nice. thanks I am just thinking the dinning room is quickly too busy at breakfast time, it could be valuable to equip your leaving room with additional table to extend breakfast area & enable everyone to take it at the time we want

reviews.name: Guest from Liskeard
reviews.comment: There were 6 of us, four from Cornwall and two from Australia. We stayed for three nights it was like a home from home, it was comfortable. We choose the B&B as it was well placed for us to visit other beautiful places in the surrounding area. The family and staff were really lovely.

reviews.name: Guest from Dalkeith
reviews.comment: Excellent accommodation

reviews.name: Guest from The Green, Dunsfold
reviews.comment: We stayed in a lovely room (Mull). The property throughout was to a very high standard. Ideally placed for exploring Glencoe etc.

reviews.name: Guest from Saint-Hyacinthe
reviews.comment: Nous avons passé trois merveilleuses nuits dans ce chambre B&B. La maison est magnifique, spacieuse et très bien entretenue. Du cabinet chauffé pour nos vêtements humides après une journée , aux pantoufles pour éviter de marcher avec nos bottes remplie de boue et du sucre à la crème dans la chambre : tout est pensé pour nous rendre la vie plus belle ! Notre chambre était décorée avec goût, le lit était confortable, et une délicate fragrance parfumait la maison, la rendant encore plus accueillante. Le petit-déjeuner était délicieux et préparé avec soin, un vrai plus pour commencer la journée! Nos hôtes ont été d'une grande gentillesse et aux petits soins tout au long de notre séjour. J'avais quelques demandes et elles ont toutes été prises en compte avec beaucoup de réactivité. Un véritable havre de paix où l'on se sent immédiatement bien. Nous recommandons cette adresse sans la moindre hésitation et y reviendrons avec grand plaisir !

reviews.name: Guest from Zürich
reviews.comment: great B&B with a beautiful view and excellent breakfast! rooms are spacious and welcoming with modern bathrooms. there is a nice sitting room as well with lots of books… you will enjoy your stay from the first minute!

reviews.name: Guest from Yarroweyah
reviews.comment: Easy check in. Access to dining area which was well set up. Beautiful room. Very clean and airy. Walk to the beach. Views are amazing. Peaceful. Stunning 😍

reviews.name: Guest from Broussard
reviews.comment: We had a fabulous stay at this B&B. It was exceptionally clean, modern, and beautifully maintained. The atmosphere was peaceful and romantic, making it the perfect place to relax and unwind. The location was excellent, and the views from the windows were absolutely beautiful. Everything about our stay exceeded our expectations and it truly felt like a dream getaway. Overall, I would highly recommend this B&B to anyone looking for a place to stay in the area. It offers a wonderful combination of comfort, tranquility, and stunning surroundings. We would definitely stay here again!

reviews.name: Guest from Wethersfield
reviews.comment: Beautiful location, nice accommodations, and easy to navigate. Loved it!

reviews.name: Guest from Houston
reviews.comment: I cannot possibly recommend Cuilcheanna House higher. What a WONDERFUL place to stay.

reviews.name: Guest from Leland
reviews.comment: We had a fantastic time at Cuilcheanna House! The location is gorgeous, the house is beautiful, and the hosts are wonderful. We are looking forward to coming back!

reviews.name: Guest from Muscat
reviews.comment: Lovely stay .. amazing views

reviews.name: Guest from Frodsham
reviews.comment: This b and b is in extensive grounds in a lovely location. It is clean and comfortable and the owners are very friendly. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

reviews.name: Guest from Chapareillan
reviews.comment: Très belle adresse avec une jolie vue. Chambre bien équipée. Juste une chose, le matelas était un peu trop mou pour nous.

reviews.name: Guest from London
reviews.comment: We really enjoyed our stay at the House, which is set in a beautiful location and equipped / supplied with quality, sustainability and its surroundings in mind. Definitely appreciate and support what the owners are doing. We particularly loved the mattress, shower and airing cupboard which were the best things to look for after a long, possibly muddy, day hiking about! The only thing is that we found our room "Iona" to be quite warm because of the pipes running in the cupboard. We managed to get it below 25° by opening the window on a cool night, but we were concerned about midges. If the stay and breakfast had been a bit more affordable we would have loved to make this our base for our stay in Scotland!

reviews.name: Guest from Henderson
reviews.comment: Absolutely beautiful location. The room was lovely. Thoroughly enjoyed our time there. Great locations between Fort William and Glencoe.

reviews.name: Guest from Wellesley
reviews.comment: This was an absolutely lovely stay and you could tell cleanliness was very important to the caretaker. They also have a whole kitchen area welcome for anyone to use so you can buy food from the grocery store and store/prep it in the kitchen, which is a huge perk and money saver! Everything was well thought out and intentional. An absolutely beautiful house with a beautiful view right on the loch (with access).

reviews.name: Guest from Whitby
reviews.comment: We absolutely loved our stay here. It was our favourite place of all the locations we stayed at in Scotland. It was beautiful, aesthetic, and Emma was lovely. The views were unbelievable, the breakfast was delicious, and we hope to come back.

reviews.name: Guest from
reviews.comment: Wonderful place to stay. Fantastic staff; very helpful. Ask them about good hikes. Well stocked dinning area to use for bringing in food. Eating dinner, overlooking the lake, is very relaxing after a day of hiking!

reviews.name: Guest from Muenchen
reviews.comment: Everything was perfect, even the weather played along. Beautiful house in a beautiful spot. We‘ll come back.

reviews.name: Guest from tirau
reviews.comment: If we could stay here forever, we would. Such a fantastic location, and perfect facilities. Emma is such a wonderful host!

reviews.name: Guest from Grand Blanc
reviews.comment: This was the one of the best accommodations I think I have ever stayed in when traveling. Emma and her family were so incredibly kind and helpful. The view from the house was gorgeous and idyllic. Breakfast was healthy and delicious (and such a lovely surprise). The room were perfect to come back and relax in after a long day of hiking. Would recommend this place first to anyone looking to stay near Glencoe! Thanks Emma and team!

reviews.name: Guest from Wigan
reviews.comment: Absolutely stunning location and our room was beautiful. Bed was perfect and great pillows! (The power shower was a bonus) Couldn’t have asked for a better night’s getaway stay. Will definitely be back if in the area again, as it was faultless.

reviews.name: Guest from Berkley
reviews.comment: Lovely and peaceful property. Very clean and comfortable.

reviews.name: Guest from kambah
reviews.comment: A very comfortable stay. The room was beautifully presented and clean. Facilities were very appreciated, including a microwave, coffee machine and a fridge to place our food.

reviews.name: Guest from Flagstaff
reviews.comment: Emma is very friendly and helpful, about things to do and local restaurants. The breakfast was gourmet, plenty to eat. Walking distance to the beach, beautiful location, very quiet. Bed and room were very comfy...Would definitely stay there again!

reviews.name: Guest from Koeniz
reviews.comment: The stay was really good. The bed is a bit small...

reviews.name: Guest from Bath Road, Twyford
reviews.comment: Honestly the best stop over we had on our trip, on fact so wonderful we changed our plans on the way back to stay again. So calm, welcoming, beautiful and a genuine child friendly b&b (that is not patronising). Our boys loved it as much, if not more than we did.

reviews.name: Guest from Tenants Harbor
reviews.comment: Absolutely the most beautiful place I have ever stayed. The location is perfect and gorgeous. The rooms are exquisite. Highly recommend. I wished I had been able to stay longer!

reviews.name: Guest from Edinburgh
reviews.comment: Incredible house and immaculately presented. For the quality of stay nothing else on booking.com comes close at this price point.

reviews.name: Guest from London
reviews.comment: Almost perfect. The house was very clean and nostalgic. Nothing to compare like a museum experience. I will never forget that experience
